Feed-toxin & liver-support focus

ELTRIXE

A toxin-management and liver-support presentation for veterinary nutritional programmes.

ELTRIXE is presented as a toxin-binder and hepatoprotectant within Rigel’s nutritional range. Its product positioning addresses feed-toxin management alongside liver support and the nutritional challenges associated with compromised feed quality.

A closer look at ELTRIXE.

The formulation belongs in a broader conversation about feed storage, ingredient quality and veterinary assessment of suspected mycotoxin exposure. The product description refers to toxin management, but it does not establish effectiveness against every toxin or replace testing, feed correction and a professionally supervised response.

What is in the formulation?

ComponentAvailable formulation detail
Formulation focusToxin-binding and liver-support presentation
Quantified ingredientsNot established from the supplied material; request the current specification

The product’s care focus.

  • Positioned around feed-toxin management and liver support.
  • A liquid veterinary presentation for integration into an assessed care programme.
  • The complete ingredient list and the scope of any toxin-binding claims require the current technical specification.

Presentation, route and administration.

The bottle identifies administration through drinking water.

Product-specific directions

A complete numerical mixing rate and course are not clearly provided. Confirm the exact formulation, preparation rate and veterinary directions before use.

Build a more useful care conversation.

Prepare these details when discussing ELTRIXE with your veterinary team.

  • Identify and address any suspected feed source rather than relying on a supplement alone.
  • Ask which toxins and use conditions the current specification actually covers.
  • Confirm compatibility with the rest of the feeding and supplementation programme.

Before you take the next step.

What should I request for ELTRIXE?+

Ask for the current product specification, the available pack size and directions for your species and market. For a commercial enquiry, include your organisation, country and the quantity or documentation you need.

Does a care category establish suitability for my animal?+

No. The exact formulation, animal’s condition and local product authorisation matter. The treating veterinarian should confirm suitability, administration and any applicable food-production withdrawal requirements.

For veterinary professionals. Product information is an overview; the current locally authorised instructions and prescribing veterinarian determine use. Pack presentation may vary.
